preconditions.description: The number of suspects n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of suspects who told the truth m must be between 0 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in answers)
preconditions.description: Each suspect's answer ai must be a valid suspect number between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines, one for each suspect.

postconditions.expression: any(line in ['Truth', 'Lie', 'Not defined'] for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must be either 'Truth', 'Lie', or 'Not defined'.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for line in stdout.splitlines() if line == 'Truth') == m
postconditions.description: The number of lines labeled 'Truth' must equal the number of suspects who told the truth, m.
